# Parse the note content to extract song titles and artists.
import re

content = note["content"]
lines = [line.strip() for line in content.split("\n") if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#")]
songs = []
for line in lines:
    # Format: "Title by Artist" or "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    match = re.match(r"^(.*?)\s+by\s+(.*)$", line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artist = match.group(2).strip()
        songs.append({"title": title, "artist": artist})
    else:
        # If no "by", treat whole line as title
        songs.append({"title": line, "artist": ""})

print(songs)

# We'll search for each song and add the matching one to the playlist.
# First, let's define a helper to find the song_id for a given title and artist(s).
def find_song_id(title, artist_str, access_token):
    # Search by title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=access_token)
    # Normalize artist names: split by comma, strip
    artist_names = [a.strip() for a in artist_str.split(",") if a.strip()]
    for song in results:
        if song["title"].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if all artist names are present in the song's artists
            song_artist_names = [a["name"].lower() for a in song["artists"]]
            if all(any(an.lower() == sa for sa in song_artist_names) for an in artist_names):
                return song["song_id"]
    # If not found, try to search with artist in query
    combined_query = f"{title} {artist_str}"
    results2 = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=combined_query, access_token=access_token)
    for song in results2:
        if song["title"].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artist_names = [a["name"].lower() for a in song["artists"]]
            if all(any(an.lower() == sa for sa in song_artist_names) for an in artist_names):
                return song["song_id"]
    return None
